outcome: neonatal birth size (specifically head circumference for gestation age z-score)
endocrine hormones (thyroid hormones: TT3; sex hormones: T)
cohort: The study included 860 mother-child pairs from the Sheyang Mini Birth Cohort Study.
finding: Higher prenatal exposure to specific neonicotinoid insecticides (NNIs) and their metabolites was associated with a decrease in neonatal head circumference for gestation age z-score, with thyroid and sex hormones partly mediating these negative associations.
cross-section timing: At birth (maternal urine samples collected on delivery days, cord serum analyzed at birth)
